title:
The "code authoring" type provides a builder pattern with natural convenience methods that allow fluent programming
when building an AST. Once the structure has been built, the #build method is called to turn it into an immutable
{@link Code} instance.

For each "leaf node" that is a direct inner type of {@link Code}, there is a corresponding node under this type.
For example, {@link Code.Not} is the logical negation unary operation and {@link Code.Authoring.Not} is its
authoring type.

This is more interesting for types with complex sub-structure because the authoring type will add methods to create
sub-structure using a fluent pattern. For example, {@link Code.Authoring.DefinedClass} has methods to create
fields and methods, which also in turn have sub-structure.
